title: Sounds like anger, and #FreeYeshua a righteous call. Still to me Heg, as a member of abolitionist movement is the kind of hero deserving of a statye.
summary: Sounds like anger, and #FreeYeshua a righteous call. Still to me Heg, as a member of abolitionist movement is the kind of hero deserving of a statye. Guess it is just the symbolism of rioting and anger that took this statue down...
